an9.14:1.1: Then Ven. Samiddhi went to Ven. Sāriputta and, on arrival, having bowed down to him, sat to one side. As he was sitting there, Ven. Sāriputta said to him,
an9.14:2.1: “Based on what, Samiddhi, do thoughts & resolves arise in a person?”
an9.14:3.1: “And how do they go to multiplicity?”
an9.14:4.1: “And what do they have as their origination?”
an9.14:4.2: “They have contact as their origination, sir.”
an9.14:5.1: “And what do they have as their meeting place?”
an9.14:5.2: “They have feeling as their meeting place, sir.”
an9.14:6.1: “And what do they have as their presiding state?”
an9.14:6.2: “They have concentration as their presiding state, sir.”
an9.14:7.1: “And what do they have as their governing principle?”
an9.14:7.2: “They have mindfulness as their governing principle, sir.”
an9.14:8.1: “And what do they have as their surpassing state?”
an9.14:8.2: “They have discernment as their surpassing state, sir.”
an9.14:9.1: “And what do they have as their heartwood?”
an9.14:9.2: “They have release as their heartwood, sir.”
an9.14:10.1: “And where do they gain their footing?”
an9.14:10.2: “They gain their footing in the deathless, sir.”
an9.14:11.1: “Samiddhi, on being asked, ‘Based on what do thoughts & resolves arise in a person?’ you have answered, ‘Based on name & form.’
an9.14:11.2: “When asked, ‘And how do they go to multiplicity?’ you have answered, ‘Through the properties.’
an9.14:11.3: “When asked, ‘And what do they have as their origination?’ you have answered, ‘They have contact as their origination.’
an9.14:11.4: “When asked, ‘And what do they have as their meeting place?’ you have answered, ‘They have feeling as their meeting place.’
an9.14:11.5: “When asked, ‘And what do they have as their presiding state?’ you have answered, ‘They have concentration as their presiding state.’
an9.14:11.6: “When asked, ‘And what do they have as their governing principle?’ you have answered, ‘They have mindfulness as their governing principle.’
an9.14:11.7: “When asked, ‘And what do they have as their surpassing state?’ you have answered, ‘They have discernment as their surpassing state.’
an9.14:11.8: “When asked, ‘And what do they have as their heartwood?’ you have answered, ‘They have release as their heartwood.’
an9.14:11.9: “When asked, ‘And where do they gain their footing?’ you have answered, ‘They gain their footing in the deathless.’
an9.14:11.11: It’s good, the way you have answered when questioned, but don’t get conceited about that.”
